Storey et al., 1997; Melluso et al., 2001). Fractional melting curves are shown for garnet and spinel lherzolite, calculated according to the
procedures of Fitton et al. (1997). Melt parameters and partition coeffi cients are given in Appendix. (B) Diagram comparing the dikes and
Madagascan basalts with the upper and lower bounds on data obtained for lavas from the Iceland Neovolcanic zone (Fitton et al., 1997).
